tagline.en: Tencent Hunyuan's interactive game-world model — drive an image-conditioned scene with directional camera controls.
tagline.zh: 腾讯混元的交互式游戏世界模型——以图像为条件,用方向性相机控制驱动场景。

en: Hunyuan GameCraft, from Tencent Hunyuan, is an interactive world model for game-style scenes. Starting from a conditioning image, it generates video that responds to directional controls, letting you steer through the scene.

It works as an image-to-video model with camera control: the demo drives a scene with forward, backward, left, and right actions and renders a continuous clip. It is built on Tencent's Hunyuan video generation stack.
In WorldFoundry it runs as an interactive-video task — supply a starting image and a sequence of movement actions, and it produces the corresponding navigated video.
zh: Hunyuan GameCraft 由腾讯混元开发,是面向游戏风格场景的交互式世界模型。它从一张条件图片出发,生成能响应方向控制的视频,让你在场景中穿行。
它以带相机控制的图生视频方式工作:官方 demo 用前进、后退、左、右等动作驱动场景,并渲染出连续片段。它构建于腾讯混元的视频生成技术栈之上。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它以交互式视频任务运行——提供一张起始图片和一串移动动作,它便生成对应的漫游视频。

whenToUse.en: Reach for GameCraft when you want to explore an image-conditioned scene interactively, driving a camera through it with directional actions to produce game-style navigation video.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想以交互方式探索一个图像条件场景、用方向动作驱动相机穿行、生成游戏风格漫游视频时,可以选择 GameCraft。

notFor.en: It targets a multi-GPU inference setup and needs the Hunyuan-GameCraft checkpoint plus its dedicated environment, so it is not a lightweight single-card option.
notFor.zh: 它面向多卡推理配置,需要 Hunyuan-GameCraft 的 checkpoint 及其专用环境,并非轻量的单卡方案。

en: Interactive game-world model with directional camera control
Image-conditioned video generation you can steer
